films.title: 100 Sunset
films.synopsis: In Toronto’s Tibetan community, Kunsel, an introverted young thief, finds an unexpected confidant in a new neighbour. As their friendship deepens, Kunsel is drawn into a web of secrets and deception.

films.title: A Talent for Murder
films.certNote: strong sex, violence, language
films.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

films.title: A Talent for Murder Unlimited Screening
films.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final instalment of the Ripley anthology.

films.title: American Doctor
films.certNote: images of real dead bodies, distressing scenes
films.synopsis: When three American doctors-Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian-enter Gaza to save lives, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth.

films.title: Andre Rieu 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow
films.synopsis:
This holiday season, celebrate the most wonderful time of the year on the big screen with André Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert – Let It Snow. This heartwarming festive spectacular, filled with beloved Christmas classics, enchanting waltzes, and magical surprises, will leave you smiling long after the final encore. Joined by his world-famous Johann Strauss Orchestra, exceptional sopranos, and a 
powerful 120-voice male choir, André brings the spirit of Christmas to life in an unforgettable musical event. Overflowing with music, laughter, and holiday cheer, this concert is perfect for the whole family. 

Whether you're surrounded by snow or simply dreaming of it, experience the magic of Christmas on the big screen with those you love. Wrap up your year with Let It Snow – only in cinemas!

films.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Starlight Express
films.synopsis:
Filmed live at the specially designed Starlight Auditorium at Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE will immerse audiences in a world of speed, song and storytelling as an incredible cast of 40 whizz across the screen, performing some of musical theatre’s most beloved songs.

As a child’s train set magically comes to life and the engines race to become the fastest in the world, Rusty the steam train has little hope of winning until he is inspired by the legend of the ‘Starlight Express’.

A show seen around the world by over 30 million people,and with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber and lyrics by Richard Stilgoe, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE is an electrifying experience for all ages.

films.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber’s Starlight Express – Live On Stage
films.synopsis: Andrew Lloyd Webber's, 'Starlight Express' races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

films.title: Animal Farm
films.synopsis: A group of farm animals rise up against their neglectful owner, dreaming of equality and freedom. But as the pigs take control, the revolution turns into tyranny, with truth rewritten and dissent crushed.

films.title: Apocalypto
films.synopsis: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

films.title: Avengers: Doomsday
films.synopsis: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.

films.title: Bachelor Party D'eux
films.synopsis:
Set against a world of crime, gang rivalries and dangerous alliances, the film follows a group of men caught up in a high-stakes gold-smuggling operation.

As rival gangs clash and trust becomes increasingly fragile, the characters face dangerous situations involving betrayal, power struggles and survival. The film combines Amal Neerad's signature stylish filmmaking with action, drama and dark humour.

films.title: Behemoth!
films.synopsis:
A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.

Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

films.title: Book Club: Elif Shafak In Conversation - Broadcast
Book Club: Impossible Creatures with Katherine Rundell
Britten’s Children
films.synopsis: Children and childhood fascinated Benjamin Britten throughout his life and inspired some of his greatest music. John Bridcut's compelling film sheds light on the composer's own inner child throiugh interviews with several of Britten's former companions and muses.

films.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG: LIVE
films.synopsis:
The record-breaking journey continues as BTS’s history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen.
Join the roar of the crowds in Kaohsiung in November and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS’s stadium tour.
Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

films.title: CBeebies Panto 2026: Treasure Island
films.synopsis:
Ahoy there, mateys young and young at heart! There will be singing, dancing and laughs for everyone this festival season, when the CBeebies Panto returns for a new adventure.

This year, the CBeebies team has reimagined the pirate classic Treasure Island, with popular performers Andy Day, Jennie Dale, Justin Fletcher, Rhys Stephenson, Rebecca Keatley and George Webster making their way across the seven seas in search of buried treasure.

With music from Banks & Wag, and a special song showing only in cinemas, this Christmas special is sure to have everyone singing, dancing and a-harr’ing along.

films.title: Cbeebies Panto: Treasure Island
films.synopsis: A swashbuckling musical reimagining of Robert Louis Stevenson's classic pirate adventure. The story follows a young boy named Jim and his dad, Bertie, as they set off on a treasure hunt across the high seas. Along the way, they encounter sneaky pirates, a chatty seagull, and a very festive holiday surprise! The lively retelling is packed with original songs and laughs, celebrating the importance of family and listening to the ones you love most.

films.title: Chicken Shop Date: The Final Series
Cinecity 2026: A Long Winter
films.synopsis: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

films.title: Cinecity 2026: Club Kid
films.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

films.title: CineCity 2026: Elsinore
films.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

films.title: Cinecity 2026: Ink
films.synopsis: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

films.title: Cinecity 2026: Mouse
films.synopsis: When her closest friendship is suddenly disrupted the summer before senior year, a teenager struggles to find her footing and develops an unexpected, complicated bond with her best friend’s mother.

films.title: Cinecity 2026: Sheep in the Box
films.synopsis: In the near future, architect Otone Komoto is married to Kensuke, who runs a construction company. The married couple decide to welcome a humanoid robot into their home as their son.

films.title: Cinecity 2026: Tender Loving Care
films.synopsis: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

films.title: Clarissa (Cinecity)
films.synopsis: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

films.title: Clayface
films.certNote: strong bloody violence, injury detail
films.synopsis: Look fear in the face. DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

films.title: Cliffhanger
films.certNote: Contains strong violence and language
films.synopsis: A botched mid-air heist results in suitcases full of cash being searched for by various groups throughout the Rocky Mountains.

films.title: Coyote vs. ACME
films.certNote: mild bad language, threat, injury detail
films.synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. Coyote teams up with  lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME.  But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.  Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

Also featuring Lana Condor (To All the Boys I've Loved Before) and the voice talents of Eric Bauza, director Dave Green (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows) mixes live action, CG, and beloved Looney Tunes legends and mayhem, to deliver a fast-paced and hilarious comedy for fans and families alike.

films.title: De Gaulle: Liberté
films.synopsis: While World War II is raging, General De Gaulle seeks to convince the world that the battle for France not lost. Reality seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

films.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
films.synopsis: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

films.title: Disney's Hexed
films.synopsis: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad and produced by Roy Conli.

films.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
films.synopsis: Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler. For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit have been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself. This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era – from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.

films.title: Dog-Friendly Screening: You Can See Everything
Double Indemnity
films.synopsis: An insurance representative is seduced by a dissatisfied housewife into a scheme of insurance fraud and murder that arouses the suspicion of his colleague, a claims investigator.

films.title: Duke's After Dark: Teenage Sex & Death at Camp Miasma (35mm) + Jane Schoenbrun Recorded Intro
films.synopsis: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

films.title: Dune: Part Two
films.synopsis: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

films.title: Ebenezer
films.certNote: moderate horror, threat, violence
films.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The classic Christmas tale. Told like never before. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

films.title: Elf
films.synopsis: When young Buddy falls into Santa's gift sack on Christmas Eve, he's transported back to the North Pole and raised as a toy-making elf by Santa's helpers. But as he grows into adulthood, he can't shake the nagging feeling that he doesn't belong. Buddy vows to visit Manhattan and find his real dad, a workaholic.

films.title: Fatherland
films.synopsis: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

films.title: Fears for Queers: Hellraiser
films.synopsis: A hedonistic man finds a mysterious puzzle box that summons a group of gruesome beings known as the Cenobites. These otherworldly entities open the doors to a dominion where pain and pleasure are indivisible.

films.title: Festive Fun with Peppa
films.synopsis: Join Peppa Pig and her family as they celebrate baby Evie’s first Christmas. This festive cinema experience brings together seven classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes, new interstitial content, and four brand-new songs with music videos. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the Christmas tree, Peppa and her family share treasured Christmas memories in this special big-screen experience.

films.title: Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience
films.certNote: no material likely to offend or harm
films.synopsis:
Join Peppa Pig and her family at the cinema for a festive big-screen experience as they celebrate Evie’s first Christmas! Share in the excitement of Christmas Day as the family of five reflect on
treasured seasonal memories. From snowy adventures and festive plays to decorating the tree, this hour-long cinema experience brings together 7 classic festive-themed Peppa Pig episodes and 4
brand-new songs that little ones can dance and sing along to. Filled with laughter, music and heartwarming moments, this special cinema experience is the perfect family day out during the
Christmas season. So grab your hats, scarves and gloves and enjoy the magic of the season along with your favourite piggies at the Festive Fun with Peppa Cinema Experience!

films.title: Fjord
films.synopsis: When a devout Romanian family resettles in a small Norwegian town, they become the subject of public scandal when their daughter shows up to school with unexplained bruises. As allegations of abuse emerge, they are swept up in an investigation that blurs the line between concern and prejudice.

films.title: Focker-in-Law
films.certNote: Moderate comic sex references and infrequent strong language.
films.synopsis:
This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

 Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.

films.title: Forgotten Island
films.certNote: threat, violence, injury detail, language, dangerous behaviour, rude humour
films.synopsis:
Your best friendship is worth fighting for.

DreamWorks Animation, the studio that brought you unforgettable bonds between a boy and a dragon in How to Train Your Dragon, an ogre and a donkey in Shrek, and a robot and a gosling in The Wild Robot, now welcomes a dazzling and emotional story about two lifelong best friends who must come together before they drift apart in Forgotten Island.

The new original film is written and directed by Academy Award® nominee Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado and is produced by Academy Award® nominee Mark Swift, the filmmaking team behind Puss in Boots: The Last Wish.

Grammy and Academy Award® winning supernova H.E.R. and Liza Soberano (Lisa Frankenstein, Alone/Together) star as high school graduates Jo and Raissa, who have been best friends since grade school but are now about to embark on separate life paths.

While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families.

Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww (Dave Franco) and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal (Tony winning icon Lea Salonga), the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

The film’s all-star voice cast also includes Emmy nominee Jenny Slate (Marcel the Shell with Shoes On, Dying for Sex), Manny Jacinto (The Good Place, Top Gun: Maverick), BAFTA nominee Dolly de Leon (Triangle of Sadness, Ghostlight), global comedy superstar Jo Koy (Haunted Mansion, Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn) and Emmy winner Ronny Chieng (The Daily Show, M3GAN).

films.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
films.certNote: moderate sex references
films.synopsis: George Michael was one of the most influential stars of his generation; his voice and songwriting defined an era. Assembled from rediscovered, previously unseen and unheard 35mm footage of his 1988 performance at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy, this new concert film captures George at the height of his creative power during the record-breaking Faith Tour. Expertly restored and remastered, the film transforms a defining cultural moment into a spectacular cinema experience. An original short film by Mary McCartney opens the feature, using newly discovered audio and imagery from 1986–1988 – the Faith era – creating a rare and intimate ‘time capsule’, offering a vivid insight into George’s mindset at this pivotal moment in his life.

films.title: Ghosts: The Possession of Button House
films.certNote: mild scary scenes, rude humour, violence, language, drug references
films.synopsis: The beloved and award-winning BBC comedy GHOSTS arrives on the big screen this Halloween. GHOSTS' stars, writers and creators Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard and Ben Willbond are back, along with Lolly Adefope, Charlotte Ritchie and Kiell Smith-Bynoe, in a feature length family adventure.

films.title: GIANT – The Play
films.certNote: discrimination references, very strong language
films.synopsis:
GIANT, the 5-star critically acclaimed play starring John Lithgow (Killers of the Flower Moon, The Crown) as Roald Dahl, comes to the big screen. Winner of 3 Olivier Awards® including Best Play and a Tony Award® for Best Actor in a Play (John Lithgow), the production was filmed live in London’s West End ahead of its sold-out Broadway run. The stellar cast includes Aya Cash (The Boys, The Franchise, You’re the Worst), Elliot Levey (Cold War, Patriots, Good) and Rachael Stirling (The Divine Mrs S).

A world-famous children’s author under threat. A battle of wills in the wake of scandal. And one chance to make amends...It’s the summer of 1983, The Witches is about to hit the shelves and Roald Dahl is making last-minute edits.  But the outcry at his recent, explicitly antisemitic article won’t die down. Across a single afternoon at his family home, and rocked by an unexpectedly explosive confrontation, Dahl is forced to choose: make a public apology or risk his name and reputation. Inspired by real events, GIANT explores with dark humour the difference between considered opinion and dangerous rhetoric offering a complicated portrait of a fiendishly charismatic icon.

films.title: Girlguiding Screening - Disney's Hexed
films.synopsis: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad and produced by Roy Conli.

films.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
films.certNote: strong injury detail
films.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. 

Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. 

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. 

There is no third time. Everything ends here.

films.title: Hadestown: The Musical
films.certNote: mild violence, injury detail, threat, sex references
films.synopsis: The live theater capture of the hit musical Hadestown, which won eight Tony Awards in 2019 including Best Musical and the 2020 Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album, featuring the five original principals of the Broadway company. The genre-defying new musical blends modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale. Following two intertwining love stories — that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and that of King Hades and his wife Persephone —Hadestowninvites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.

films.title: Hadestown: The Musical
films.certNote: mild violence, injury detail, threat, sex references
films.synopsis: The international hit musical comes to the big screen! Winner of eight Tony Awards in 2019 including Best Musical and the 2020 Grammy Award for Best Musical Theater Album, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL is the genre-defying musical blending modern American folk music with New Orleans-inspired jazz to reimagine a sweeping ancient tale of two intertwining love stories, that of young dreamers Orpheus and Eurydice, and King Hades and his wife Persephone. Filmed live on stage in London’s West End and featuring the original Broadway stars, HADESTOWN: THE MUSICAL invites audiences on a hell-raising journey to the underworld and back.

films.title: Home Alone + Mulled Wine & Festive Cakes
How to Rob a Bank
films.certNote: strong language, violence, drug misuse
films.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their beliefs - and their most ambitious heist yet.

films.title: I Love Boosters
films.synopsis: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

films.title: I Play Rocky
films.certNote: moderate sex references, violence, injury detail, strong language
films.synopsis: A struggling actor with a partially paralyzed face and a speech impediment writes a script that a big movie studio wants to buy, but he refuses to sell it unless he gets to play the lead. Turning down an offer of life-changing money, he instead works for pennies to get the movie made with himself in the starring role. The movie becomes the biggest box office hit of 1976, notching ten Oscar nominations and winning Best Picture. The true story of the making of the iconic movie Rocky.

films.title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
films.synopsis: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

films.title: In the Shadows
films.synopsis: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

films.title: It's A Wonderful Life (80th Anniversary)
films.synopsis:
Beset with personal and professional problems, George Bailey finds his previously happy life falling apart around him on Christmas Eve. Seeing no way out, George considers suicide from the edge of a bridge - but Clarence, his guardian angel, intervenes and shows George what his beloved hometown of Bedford Falls would be like without him.

Shocked by what he sees and at the unforeseen circumstances of his absence, George reconsiders and begs Clarence to return him to the problems of the present and the loving community he has fostered throughout his life.

films.title: Jet Lag: The Game — Hide + Seek Italy
Ken Russell's The Devils
films.synopsis: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

films.title: La Bola Negra
films.certNote: strong language, injury detail, violence, sex, nudity
films.synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA is a bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history from the 30s to modern day. The film tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance.

films.title: La Bola Negra + Discussion with writers William Rayfet Hunter and Alexandra Heminsley
Lost Christmas
films.synopsis: Christmastime brings out the best and the worst in people. At the office Christmas party, assumptions are made and rumors are confirmed. The Christmas spirit is finally revealed.

films.title: Making Marie Antoinette
films.synopsis: Eleanor Coppola turns her camera on her daughter, Sofia, as she shoots Marie Antoinette. Catching every detail of the behind-the-scenes and on-set action, Eleanor captures the feat of Sofia’s directing a landmark film aged 34, and muses on what it means for a mother to watch her daughter at work.

films.title: Marie Antoinette (20th Anniversary)
films.certNote: strong sex, brief drug misuse
films.synopsis: Biopic of the beautiful Queen of France who became a symbol for the wanton extravagance of the 18th century monarchy, and was stripped of her riches and finery, imprisoned and beheaded by her own subjects during the French Revolution that began in 1789.

films.title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
films.synopsis: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

films.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint + Q&A
films.synopsis: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

Met Opera Live 2026-27: Samson et Dalila
Minotaur
films.synopsis: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

films.title: Nuisance Bear (Cinecity)
films.synopsis: A polar bear is forced to navigate a human world of tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as its ancient migration collides with modern life. When a sacred predator is branded a nuisance, it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.

films.title: ODEON Pride Nights - We Will Find Happiness
films.synopsis: Saad, a young Moroccan migrant, plans to make a dangerous journey to Canada with his Iranian lover Reza. When Reza faces deportation from Montreal to Iran—where he risks severe punishment or even death—Saad does everything in his power to save him. In a desperate attempt to prevent the deportation, Saad decides to seduce an influential spokesperson from the Ministry of Immigration. This risky choice places him in a moral conflict between love and opportunism, setting off a chain of events in which desire collides with political reality. The film offers a poignant portrayal of the vulnerable position of LGBTQ+ refugees and the consequences of contemporary immigration policies.

films.title: One in a Million
films.synopsis: On the heights of Los Angeles, Nathan, 18, dreams of Hollywood. He seems to be trapped in the strange house he lives in.

films.title: Onslaught
films.synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

films.title: Pip and Posy: Sandpit Friends
films.synopsis: Pip and Posy play in the sandpit, make clay food, avoid imaginary crocodiles, watch falling stars and play with their friends.

Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg as they face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

A young, ambitious trial lawyer (Cynthia Erivo) brilliantly navigates the ruthless London court system where she is unmatched in her defense of the accused, including men charged with sexual assault. Just as her career is taking off, a life-altering event forces her to reckon with her belief in the judicial system that was once the core of her identity.

films.title: Primetime
films.certNote: child sexual abuse references, sex references, violence, nudity, language
films.synopsis: Inspired by true events in 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice in this candy-colored thriller from Lance Oppenheim.

films.title: Prisoners
films.synopsis: Your child is missing. Every second counts. How far would you go? When his six year old daughter Anna goes missing along with her friend Joy, Keller Dover faces every parent's worst nightmare. The only lead is a dilapidated RV that had been spotted earlier on the street. Detective Loki is put in charge of the investigation and immediately arrests the driver of the RV, Alex Jones, however a lack of physical evidence forces them to release him. With the police pursuing different leads to no avail and his family life disintegrating, a desperate Keller decides to take matters into his own hands. But just how far will he go to save his daughter?

films.title: Ramayana (Hindi)
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat
films.synopsis:
Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi.

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG is behind films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in cinemas in time for Diwali on November 5.

films.title: Ramayana: Rise of A Legend
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat
films.synopsis: For millions around the world, the Ramayana is a living legacy passed from one generation to the next, with themes of duty, courage, compassion, sacrifice, and righteousness that have shaped literature, art, and culture across civilizations.

films.title: RBO Cinema Season 2026-27: The Nutcracker
films.synopsis:
At a cosy Christmas party, young Clara meets the mysterious magician Drosselmeyer, who gives her a nutcracker doll. When the guests have departed and the house is asleep, Clara sneaks downstairs in search of the doll. Instead, she finds Drosselmeyer, who whisks her away on a journey into a whole world of enchantment: fantastical landscapes of flurried snow and glittering confection where toys come alive and the magic never stops. 
Peter Wright’s production of this festive family favourite sparkles to the wondrous swell of Tchaikovsky’s orchestral score, alongside the glow and grandeur of Julia Trevelyan Oman’s period designs.

Resident Evil

films.synopsis:
From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise.

In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
films.certNote: very mild threat, scary scenes, rude humour, implied bad language
films.synopsis: Everyone is looking forward to Halloween on Mossy Bottom Farm - until the clumsy Farmer trashes the Flock's beloved pumpkin patch! But when Shaun turns MAD SCIENTIST to fix the problem, things rapidly spiral out of control. With the Farmer missing and a wild beast roaming the woods of Mossingham, all the ingredients are in place for a monstrously fun family adventure...

films.title: Silent Friend (Cinecity)
films.synopsis: In the heart of a botanical garden in a medieval university town in Germany stands a majestic ginkgo tree. This silent witness has observed over a century the quiet rhythms of transformation across three human lives. At three distinct moments across the 20th and 21st centuries, these people — each carrying their own questions and inner struggles — inevitably find themselves drawn into the presence of this tree, full of mystery and meaning.

films.title: Slava: Shooting with Music
films.synopsis: After completing more than 200 concerts for the troops, Slava Vakarchuk - frontman of Ukraine’s most successful rock band, Okean Elzy - was encouraged to take his band on a worldwide tour to bolster the morale of Ukrainian refugees living abroad, and to leave a lasting legacy of Ukrainian culture on the rest of the world. An international coalition of artists, including Coldplay, stepped up to support them.

films.title: Street Fighter
films.certNote: violence, injury detail, threat, sex references, infrequent strong language
films.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

films.title: Sunset Boulevard (75th Anniversary 4K Restoration)
films.synopsis: A hack screenwriter writes a screenplay for a former silent film star who has faded into Hollywood obscurity.

films.title: Superworm
films.synopsis: Superworm is super-long and super-strong, and is always saving the day. But who can save him when he gets too full of himself and is captured by the evil Wizard Lizard?

films.title: The Apartment
films.synopsis: Bud Baxter is a minor clerk in a huge New York insurance company, until he discovers a quick way to climb the corporate ladder. He lends out his apartment to the executives as a place to take their mistresses. Although he often has to deal with the aftermath of their visits, one night he's left with a major problem to solve.

films.title: The Cat in the Hat
films.synopsis: In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, doing what he does best - spreading joy to "happyless" kids. In the film, The Cat takes on his toughest assignment yet... to cheer a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town.

films.title: The Color of Money
films.synopsis: Former pool hustler "Fast Eddie" Felson decides he wants to return to the game by taking a pupil. He meets talented but green Vincent Lauria and proposes a partnership. As they tour pool halls, Eddie teaches Vincent the tricks of scamming, but he eventually grows frustrated with Vincent's showboat antics, leading to an argument and a falling-out. Eddie takes up playing again and soon crosses paths with Vincent as an opponent.

films.title: The Education of Jane Cumming (Cinecity)
films.synopsis: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

films.title: THE FOUR
films.synopsis: Four women bound by an unbreakable friendship face their greatest test when the son of one of them is wrongfully imprisoned, forcing them to confront a powerful and corrupt system in a daring fight to prove his innocence.

films.title: THE FOUR - World Premiere

films.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
films.synopsis: Showcases more of Cliff Booth's backstory in his new role as a Hollywood fixer.

The Match

films.synopsis: Follows the 1986 Argentina-England World Cup quarter final, exploring how the match became a culmination of tensions between the two nations following the 1982 Falklands War.

films.title: The Muppet Christmas Carol
films.synopsis: A retelling of the classic Dickens tale of Ebenezer Scrooge, miser extraordinaire. He is held accountable for his dastardly ways during nighttime visitations by the Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Future.

films.title: The Polar Express
films.certNote: mild threat
films.synopsis: A young boy lies awake in his room one snowy Christmas Eve, excited and alert. Breathing silently. Hardly moving. Waiting. He's listening for a sound he's afraid that he might never hear--the ringing bells of Santa's sleigh. The time is five minutes to midnight. Suddenly, a thunderous roar startles the boy. Clearing the mist from his window he sees the most amazing sight--a gleaming black train rumbles to a stop right in front of his house, the steam from its powerful engine hissing through the night sky and the softly falling snowflakes. The boy rushes outside, clad only in his pajamas and slippers, and is met by the train's conductor who seems to be waiting just for him. "Well, are you coming?" the conductor inquires. "Where?" the boy asks. "Why, to the North Pole--of course. This is the Polar Express!" What unfolds is an adventure that follows a doubting young boy, who takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole; during this ride, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

films.title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
films.synopsis:
Baba Segi is a proud, prosperous and uneducated Yoruba patriarch with three uneducated wives and seven children, a household he sees as a testament to his status, virility and legacy. Its strict hierarchy is governed by tradition: Iya Segi, the formidable first wife, rules with authority; Iya Tope survives through quiet obedience; and Iya Femi quietly plots for greater infuence.
 
Their fragile balance is shattered when Baba Segi marries Bolanle, an educated young woman he hopes will add to his family and legacy. To the other wives, her arrival is a threat. But when Bolanle fails to conceive, her inability to bear a child becomes a matter of growing concern in a household where children are central to a man’s legacy and a woman’s place within the family.
 
As pressure mounts, suspicion turns to resentment and the household’s carefully guarded secrets begin to unravel, exposing hidden paternity, betrayal and the devastating cost of silence.
 
Adapted from the acclaimed novel, The Secret Lives of Baba Segi’s Wives is a gripping and 
darkly humorous story of marriage, power, jealousy, fertility and survival, told 
unapologetically through a distinctly Yoruba and Nigerian lens.

films.title: The Silence of the Lambs
films.synopsis: Clarice Starling is a top student at the FBI's training academy.  Jack Crawford wants Clarice to interview Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brilliant psychiatrist who is also a violent psychopath, serving life behind bars for various acts of murder and cannibalism.  Crawford believes that Lecter may have insight into a case and that Starling, as an attractive young woman, may be just the bait to draw him out.

films.title: THE SNOWMAN™ & THE SNOWMAN™ AND THE SNOWDOG
films.synopsis:
The Snowman™ film, adapted from Raymond Briggs’ classic picture book, is a family favourite. A timeless, magical tale of a boy whose snowman comes to life at midnight, it has captured the imagination of generations – and continues to enchant.

The animated sequel The Snowman™ and The Snowdog beautifully captures the magic and excitement of the original film as well as being a heart-warming story about love, loss and friendship. When a young boy, Billy, moves house, he discovers a secret box hidden under the floorboards – a snowman-making kit! Billy builds his snowman and, with a little spare snow, a Snowdog. At midnight, The Snowman and The Snowdog magically come to life. Join Billy on the most amazing adventure, as they fly over London to the North Pole and compete with an assortment of colourful characters in a very special race. On return, Billy must leave his new friends outside and return to bed – but first, a wonderful surprise awaits him…

UKJFF 2026: British-Jewish Life on Film: Brighton + Q&A
UKJFF 2026: The Soundman (2025)
films.synopsis: May 1940. As Europe trembles on the brink of war, two lives cross within Brussels’ legendary Flagey building, the beating heart of national radio. Elza, a young actress making her debut in radio drama, meets Berre, a gifted soundman with a magical ear. She is enchanted by storytelling; he finds solace in sound. Their encounter sparks a love that dares to exist beyond the rising shadow of their time.

films.title: Violent Night 2
films.synopsis: Santa's back. And he's not happy. From 87North, the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde, Nobody and this summer's Nobody 2, comes a new chapter in yuletide mayhem: VIOLENT NIGHT 2. In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee David Harbour), armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of ruthless mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, it's time for not-so-jolly Saint Nick to suit up again.

films.title: Wicker
films.certNote: strong sex, language, sex references, injury detail
films.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

films.title: Wild Horse Nine
films.certNote: very strong language, strong violence, drug misuse
films.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students (Mariana di Girolamo and Ailín Salas) threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

films.title: Wildwood
films.certNote: moderate violence, injury detail, threat, language, upsetting scenes
films.synopsis:
After her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, headstrong teenager Prue McKeel (Peyton Elizabeth Lee) launches a desperate rescue mission into the Impassable Wilderness—
an enchanted forest hidden just beyond Portland, Oregon. Joined by her hapless but loyal classmate Curtis Mehlberg (Jacob Tremblay), Prue navigates a world of talking animals, bandits, and powerful figures driven by grief and ambition. As the pair is drawn into a conflict threatening the balance of the forest itself, Prue must discover the strength and belief she never knew she possessed. If she hopes to save her brother and protect Wildwood’s fragile future, she will have to risk everything. From Oscar®-nominated and BAFTA®-winning LAIKA, Wildwood is a sweeping adventure about love, sacrifice, and the magic that reveals itself when we dare to look beyond the familiar.

films.title: Witness for the Prosecution
films.synopsis: An ailing barrister is thrust back into the courtroom in what becomes one of the most unusual and eventful murder cases of the lawyer's career when he finds himself defending a man being tried for the murder of a socialite.

films.title: World Children's Day: Willy Wonka and The Chocolate Factory
You Can See Everything
films.certNote: strong language
films.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to  document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

films.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
films.certNote: Strong violence and bloody injury throughout. Strong language and sex references.
films.synopsis: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.
